subject: RFP: Security & Compliance Questionnaire — Redwood Inference
messages:
From: Asha Nair <asha.nair@titancloud.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@titancloud.com; security@titancloud.com
Date: 2026-10-12T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: RFP: Security & Compliance Questionnaire — Redwood Inference

Vanessa,

Thanks for engaging — Titan Cloud is evaluating vendors for our AI stack and we need to complete a security and compliance pass for Redwood as part of the RFP. Attached is our SIG questionnaire (Titan_SIG_2026.xlsx) and a short artifact checklist. Key asks up front:

- Latest SOC 2 Type II report (redacted OK)
- ISO 27001 certificate
- Recent external penetration test summary
- Data flow diagrams and network topology for tenant isolation
- Control mappings (SIG/ISO/SOC2) where possible

Can we get an initial artifact drop by EOD Friday 2026-10-16? If you prefer, we can split items into a prioritized delivery. Also, please confirm whether you will accept a redacted SOC2 and how you treat evidence access.

I’ve cc’d procurement and security — happy to hop on a 30-min call if that helps.

Regards,
Asha Nair
Senior InfoSec Manager
Titan Cloud
Attachments: Titan_SIG_2026.xlsx, Titan_Artifact_Checklist.pdf
From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
To: Asha Nair <asha.nair@titancloud.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai; marissa_cole@redwood.ai; karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-12T09:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: RFP: Security & Compliance Questionnaire — Redwood Inference

Hi Asha — thanks for the SIG and the checklist. We can support your run and target the prioritized drop by EOD 2026-10-16. Rishi and Marissa from our security & compliance teams are looped in to coordinate artifacts.

Proposed approach (short):
1) Deliverables by 2026-10-16: redacted SOC 2 Type II report, ISO 27001 certificate, high-level data flow diagram, network topology PDF, artifact_manifest.csv.
2) Deliverables by 2026-10-20: control-mapping spreadsheet (SIG->SOC2/ISO), pen test executive summary (redacted).
3) If Titan requires access to underlying evidence (e.g., audit logs), we can provide redacted exports or arrange a scoped evidence review under NDA — please indicate preference.

Action items for our side: Rishi will own SOC2/pen test artifacts, Marissa will produce control mapping and diagrams, Karthik will coordinate any procurement/redlines.

Two quick questions for your intake:
- Will a redacted SOC2 PDF suffice or do you need a secure review session?
- Any specific SIG sections you want prioritized (e.g., Cryptography, Access Control, Logging)?

I’ve attached an artifact_manifest template to speed uploads.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference

- SOC2: We have a redacted SOC2 Type II covering 2025-09 to 2026-09. I will pull the PDF and validate redactable sections. Expected delivery to Vanessa for review by 10/14 EOD. (file: SOC2_Type2_2025-2026.pdf)
- ISO27001: Certificate is publicly available; will attach the cert PDF (ISO27001_Certificate_2025.pdf).
- Pen test: Executive summary available from our external vendor — redacted for customer PII; target 10/20.
- Data flow / network diagrams: Marissa will own the diagrams; we have a vetted DFD v2 and network topolgy v4.
- KMS/key rotation policy: We can provide our KMS key rotation policy doc (kms_key_rotation_policy.pdf) and a short narrative on KMS HSM integration.

If Titan wants the full control mapping (SIG -> SOC2 control IDs -> evidence references), we will prepare control_mapping_SIG-Redwood-2026.xlsx. That will show where each SIG question maps to our SOC2 control and where to find evidence.

I recommend we schedule a 30-min kickoff for 10/13 to align on redaction rules and evidence access. Vanessa — want me to send calendar invite or should Karthik coordinate times with Asha?

-Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Director, Security Engineering
Redwood Inference

Hi Asha / Vanessa,

Quick status from Compliance: we can meet the proposed split. Summary of what we will attach and when: 

- 2026-10-16 (initial drop):
  - SOC2_Type2_2025-2026.pdf (redacted executive and user PII)
  - ISO27001_Certificate_2025.pdf
  - data_flow_diagram_v2.png (annotated for tenant boundaries)
  - network_diagram_v4.pdf (segmentation and public/private zones)
  - artifact_manifest.csv (list + short descriptions)

- 2026-10-20 (control mapping and pen test):
  - control_mapping_SIG-Redwood-2026.xlsx (SIG -> SOC2 control IDs -> evidence locations)
  - PenTest_Summary_2026-09.pdf (vendor exec summary, redacted)

Notes on redaction and evidence access:
- Redacted SOC2 is acceptable for procurement reviews; for a full SOC2 readout we require an NDA + brief evidence session.
- We will not provide raw VM snapshots or user PII in artifacts.
- For logging/audit extracts, we can provide time-windowed, redacted logs or a scoped search result export.

I will upload items to the shared drive and send you links when available. Karthik — please confirm if procurement prefers direct Drive links or an S3 pre-signed bundle.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Compliance Manager

From: Asha Nair <asha.nair@titancloud.com>

Thanks — that timeline looks reasonable. A couple of clarifying questions before the 10/16 drop:

1) Key rotation / cryptography: can you confirm whether customer data keys are rotated on a 90-day cadence or policy is different? Also which KMS (cloud-native vs HSM) is used for tenant keys?

2) Control mapping granularity: our security team asks that SIG mappings include the SOC2 Trust Service Criteria IDs where possible (e.g., CC6.1) and a short note about evidence type (artifact, config snapshot, interview). Will that be included in control_mapping_SIG-Redwood-2026.xlsx?

3) Doc handling: procurement would prefer a DocuSign NDA before access to any unredacted exhibits — I’ve sent a DocuSign link to Vanessa (FAKE-DS-123456789).

If you can confirm (1) rotation cadence and KMS type, and (2) confirm the mapping format, we’ll mark the RFP as on-track.

Best,
Asha
Senior InfoSec Manager
Titan Cloud
From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
To: Asha Nair <asha.nair@titancloud.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai; marissa_cole@redwood.ai; karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-15T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: RFP: Security & Compliance Questionnaire — Redwood Inference

Asha — thanks for the questions and for sending the NDA link. Quick confirmations and next steps: 

- KMS & rotation: Tenant encryption keys are managed in a cloud HSM-backed KMS (customer keys are envelope-encrypted). Keys used for tenant data are rotated on a 90-day policy for DEKs (data encryption keys); CMKs have a 2-year rotation/rekeying schedule but are rotated sooner if cryptographic guidelines change. We will include the kms_key_rotation_policy.pdf in the initial drop.

- Control mapping: Yes — control_mapping_SIG-Redwood-2026.xlsx will include SIG question mappings to SOC2 control IDs and a column that indicates evidence type (Artifact / Config / Interview / Log Export).

Plan: we will upload the initial artifact bundle to a secured drive and email links by EOD 2026-10-16. If you complete the NDA via DocuSign, please flag the signed envelope and we’ll prepare the scoped evidence exports for your review.

Attachments to follow on 10/16 (initial): SOC2_Type2_2025-2026.pdf (redacted), ISO27001_Certificate_2025.pdf, data_flow_diagram_v2.png, network_diagram_v4.pdf, artifact_manifest.csv, kms_key_rotation_policy.pdf

If you prefer an S3 bundle instead of Drive links, Karthik — can you arrange the pre-signed bundle and share instructions with procurement?

Thanks — looking forward to getting this over the finish line.

Best regards,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
